name: Murakumo Ten
source:
Ten is lazy scumbag who is skilled in the art of flattery. He attends many drinking parties, so his social circle is wide. However, there is no one who can understand him on an intimate level.

[From [url=https://wiki.18t.rip/wiki/Ten_Murakumo]18TRIP Wiki[/url]]
